name: Magik

abilityDetails.Dodge: Gelen bir temel saldırıdan veya temaslı özel saldırıdan geriye kaçarak kaçınma; Çeviklik ustalığı bu pencereyi genişletir.
abilityDetails.Neutralize: Buff yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Falter: Rakibin bir sonraki saldırısının ıskalamasına sebep olur.
abilityDetails.Buff Deceleration: Etkilenen şampiyondaki buff'ların tik hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Buff Acceleration: Etkilenen şampiyondaki buff'ların tik hızını artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Güç barı dolunca 2,5sn'lik Limbo bonusu uygular (özel saldırılarında duraklar) — Limbo aktifken süresi dolan her bonus degeneration tetikler. Limbo bitince bloktan aldığı hasarın %100'ünü ve toplam hasarın %50'sini anında iyileştirir. Bonus immün şampiyon Limbo'yu tamamen engeller. İyileşme bloğu/tersine çevirme + bonus immünitesi olan şampiyon yok denecek kadar az; bazı bonus-immün Science şampiyonlar (Titania, Ant-Man, Spider-Man 2099, Cassie Lang) despair yeterliliğiyle iyileşmesini güçlü şekilde azaltabilir.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: While Dodging back, Magik cannot be struck by Attacks.
While Defending the Potency of the Mystic Dispersion Mastery is reduced by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Limbo - Buff
content: Upon filling a Bar of Power, Magik puts the Opponent in Limbo by placing a Limbo Buff on them for 2.5 seconds, paused during Special Attacks.
While in Limbo, the Opponent is inflicted with a 75% Neutralize Passive. Against Cosmic Opponents, this potency is 125% instead.
When triggering Limbo, Magik also places an indefinitely +0 Fury Buff on the Opponent.
Each Buff that ends on the Opponent while in Limbo inflicts a Degeneration Passive dealing [1589.75] Direct Damage over 20 seconds. Max Stacks: 10.
All Degeneration effects are paused while in Limbo.
If Limbo ends while Magik has less Health than when it started, she instantly Regnerates 100% of Blocked Damage and 50% of all other damage taken during Limbo.
Limbo will not re-trigger while already active.

abilitySections.title: Falter - Passive
content: While the Opponent is in Limbo, charging a Heavy Attack inflicts a Falter Passive that increases the Opponent's aggression for 1.5 seconds.
While the Opponent is in Limbo, Dashing forwards inflicts a Falter Passive for the duration of the Dash.
In an attack Misses as the result of either of these Falters, both go on cooldown until Limbo ends.

abilitySections.title: When Charing a Heavy Attack
content: If the Opponent is in Limbo, apply a 80% Buff Deceleration Passive to them until Imbo ends, and remove any other Personal Buff Acceleration or Deceleration effects.
If the Opponent is in Limbo, gain an Unblockable Passive until the end of the Heavy Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: The Opponent cannot gain Power while being struck by or Blocking these attacks.
If the Opponent is in Limbo, apply a 400% Buff Acceleration Passive to them until Limbo ends, and remove any other personal Buff Acceleration or Deceleration effects.

During Magik's Special Attacks all personal Degeneration effects on the Opponent become Dire, increasing their tick rate by 400%. As a Defender they only become Dire if the Special Attack hits or is Blocked by the Attacker.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The final 2 hits each Nullify 1 Fury Buff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: For every 2 Degenerations the Opponent was suffering from at the start of this attack, each hit inflicts 1 Degeneration Passive dealing [784.88] Direct Damage over 3 seconds. Max stacks: 20.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: On activation, this attack gains +[1,589.75] Attack Rating for each Buff and Degeneration effect on the Opponent up to 20 total.
Nullify all Buffs on the Opponent other than Limbo.
Refresh all Degeneration and Limbo effects on the Opponent, and pause them for 3 seconds.
All personal Degeneration effects on the Opponent become Dire, increasing their tick rate by 400% for 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Darkchylde
content: When a Limbo Buff is placed on the Opponent, also inflict a non-stacking Degeneration Passives, dealing [3,140] Direct Damage over 20 seconds.
